subject: gk
question: Which city will host the 2032 Summer Olympic Games?
solution:
The correct answer is __Brisbane__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• American executive Cindy Hook has been appointed as the inaugural **CEO of the organising committee for the 2032 Olympic and Paralympic Games in Brisbane.**
 
• The organising committee announced the appointment on** December 13 after engaging with 50 candidates over six months.**
 
• Hook was based in Singapore as **CEO of Deloitte Asia Pacific until June and had previously worked for the international professional services network in the US and in Australia, moving to Sydney in 2009 to lead the auditing practice for six years and later becoming CEO of the Australian operation in 2015.**
 
• The International Olympic Committee awarded the **2032 Games to Brisbane in July of last year, under a revamped procedure for choosing host cities that saw a small group of IOC members identify and propose host cities to the board.**
 
• **Australia has twice previously hosted the Summer Olympics, at Melbourne in 1956 and Sydney in 2000.**
 
• **The 2032 organizing committee held its first board meeting in April and, on** July 23, started the decade-long countdown.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **2032 Summer Olympics, officially known as the Games of the XXXV Olympiad and also known as Brisbane 2032, **will be an international multi-sport event scheduled to take place from **23 July to 8 August 2032, in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia.**
 
• Following changes in the bidding rules, the **International Olympic Committee selected and announced Brisbane as the winning bid on 21 July 2021, two days before the start of the 2020 Summer Olympics.**
